VBO:0200993.summary: Affectionate close company and toy play recur in adult rescue accounts of the Pekepoo, a Pekingese–Poodle cross. Willow greets familiar people with stuffed animals, chases squirrels and barks at deliveries. Morrie enjoys walks, toys and couch time beside his person. Both accounts also describe anxiety and strong reactions around particular people, dogs or possessions.
